title: Season Settlement Basis for the Volume Discount on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
**1. What the discount answers.** The volume discount a member has earned on a crop input account for the crop year just closed is granted once, after the season has closed, and is written against the last invoice raised on the account in that season.

**2. The season window.** The season window is the 14 statement months before the handling date.

**3. The season spend.** The season spend the discount is earned on is everything invoiced to the account over the fourteen statement months before the handling date, less every credit memo written on the account over those months, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places.

**4. The rate.** The volume discount rate is the rate the programme carries.

**5. The qualifying spend.** The qualifying spend the rate acts on is the part of the season spend above the programme's volume discount threshold, and where the season spend does not reach that threshold the qualifying spend is nil.

**6. The delivered grain bonus.** The delivered grain bonus added to the rate is nil.

**7. The settlement record uplift.** The settlement record uplift added to the rate is nil.

**8. The discount granted.** The discount granted is the qualifying spend multiplied by the volume discount rate, the delivered grain bonus and the settlement record uplift taken together as one total rate, applied once to the qualifying spend and rounded half away from zero to two decimal places; the three components are combined into one rate before they are applied and they do not act one after the other.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take a member on a programme of the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts whose volume discount threshold is 150000.00 USD and whose volume discount rate is 1.5 percent.

| Step | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| Invoiced to the account over the season window | 180000.00 USD |
| Credit memos written on the account over the season window | 4500.00 USD |
| Season spend, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places | 175500.00 USD |
| Part of the season spend above the programme's threshold | 25500.00 USD |
| Volume discount rate | 1.5 percent |
| Delivered grain bonus | nil |
| Settlement record uplift | nil |
| The three taken together as one total rate | 1.5 percent |
| Discount granted, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places | 382.50 USD |

Had the same member's season spend come to 140000.00 USD, it would not reach the programme's threshold, the qualifying spend would be nil, and the discount granted would be nil.
